$comment: AndroidX sample FILES this catalog cannot import, each with the reason. A declared, CHECKED gap -- scripts/import-samples.mjs skips these and a test fails when one becomes importable again -- so an exclusion cannot rot into a permanent one nobody revisits. Same contract kit-unauthorable.json carries for kit cells. EMPTY on purpose today: the quarantine is only honest once the :samples-catalog module exists and a compile says which samples genuinely cannot build, so entries are added from a real failure rather than guessed ahead of one.
